control/mac-evidence-audit-log-path-corr.scope: Independent read-only audit; no benchmark harness imported or benchmark rerun. Only audit artifacts written.
control/mac-evidence-audit-log-path-corr.prototype_scope_verified: Per-chunk Foundation autorelease pool on Objective-C platforms; helper extraction on Linux. Reader byte loop, Data loader, EOF flush, diagnostic conversion and parsing unchanged.
limits: This auditor was adapted from the earlier independent coalescing audit; it imports no timing or differential harness code.
External nanoseconds originate in raw sample records; native time only supports a hundredth-second sanity check, not exact reconstruction.
Original independent coverage receipts and outputs were hash-verified; the coverage algorithm was not rerun.
Six pairs per workload validate this controlled Mac experiment, not cross-platform performance.
Profile heap snapshots count live storage; they do not measure total allocation count or peak RSS. Parsing snapshots are not aligned by record count.
Post-render profiling intentionally blocks an output pipe; no profiling duration is treated as ordinary elapsed-time evidence.
Baseline retention does not identify a retaining root; the pool intervention removes the observed storage accumulation in the captured phases.
